description: Red is mother's heartbreak era and it is CHAOS in the best way 😭✨ One minute she's screaming 'We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together' and the next she's sobbing 'All Too Well'. The emotional whiplash of it all is exactly what falling apart feels like. It's country pop perfection and the Jake Gyllenhaal lore is everywhere. A classic, but it's long and uneven, so not quite a 5 💅🔥
